request: Investigate the hold-up on order ORD-1008.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its fulfillment status, warehouse, items, and promised delivery date.
I will check inventory for both SKUs at WH-DAL since the order is still pending on its ship-by date, to see if stock is blocking fulfillment.
I will look for another warehouse that alone can cover the shortfall of 10 units of SKU-303, excluding WH-DAL, to support a transfer.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1008 is blocked by a stock shortage at the fulfillment warehouse for one line item (SKU-303). The order is not yet overdue (promised 2026-03-17), but without resolving the shortage it cannot ship complete.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1008 for Woodgrove Clinic, fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-DAL, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, ship_by_date 2026-03-16, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17 (is_past_promised_date false); items: SKU-303 qty 30, SKU-606 qty 100
check_inventory: SKU-303 at WH-DAL on_hand 22, reserved 2, available 20 (ordered 30)
check_inventory: SKU-606 at WH-DAL on_hand 250, reserved 0, available 250 (ordered 100)
find_alternative_stock: for SKU-303 required_quantity 10, WH-BOS available 50 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 6 false; WH-CHI available 5 false
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient stock of SKU-303 at WH-DAL (available 20 vs ordered 30) preventing complete fulfillment.
uncertainties: Transfer lead time from WH-BOS to WH-DAL may affect whether remaining units can arrive by 2026-03-17.
Customer acceptance of a split shipment (20 units of SKU-303 now, 10 later) is unknown.

recommended_actions.details: Arrange an immediate transfer of 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL to cover the shortfall; supported by find_alternative_stock: WH-BOS available 50 can_cover_required_quantity true for required_quantity 10, and check_inventory: WH-DAL available 20 vs ordered 30.

From WH-DAL, ship all available items now: SKU-606 (100 units) and SKU-303 (20 units), with the remaining 10 units of SKU-303 to follow after transfer; justified by check_inventory: SKU-606 available 250 (ordered 100) and SKU-303 available 20 (ordered 30), and get_order_details promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17.

Inform Woodgrove Clinic about the partial shipment plan and provide an ETA for the remaining 10 units of SKU-303 once the WH-BOS transfer is scheduled; this is warranted by the documented shortage (check_inventory: SKU-303 available 20 vs ordered 30) and the near-term promised date (get_order_details: 2026-03-17).

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL immediately and ship available items now, notifying the customer about the split shipment and ETA for the remaining 10 units.
